title: capture_sync: Don't exit a command on a log msg
description:
If dumpcap sends along a log message when running a command as a
capture child (e.g., retrieving the interface list), don't exit
at that point. Continue looping and try to read more bytes until
either there's a success or failure.

This is similar to what's done in sync_inteface_stats_open(). Perhaps
the code could be consolidated at some point.

Fixes segfaults or not detecting interfaces if tshark or Wireshark
is run with log level noisy or similar that will cause logs during
interface retrieval.
